items.title: Bit2Watt: A Cyber-Physical Vulnerability Exploiting GPU Workloads Across Power and Computing Infrastructures
items.summary: Modern data centers increasingly rely on large-scale GPU clusters and on-site renewable energy resources, resulting in a tightly coupled cyber-physical system between computing workloads and power-electronic-dominated grids. In this paper, we reveal Bit2Watt, a previously unexplored vulnerability in which an adversary manipulates GPU workloads to induce controlled, high-frequency power modulations that destabilize local power infrastructure and propagate back to disrupt computing services. Unlike traditional attacks that compromise grid-side devices or communication channels, Bit2Watt operates entirely within the cyber layer as a legal tenant, which could amplify fluctuations, harmonic distortion, and damping degradation, particularly in high-DER-penetration scenarios. This risk is difficult to detect under routine cloud- and facility-side monitoring because it exploits legitimate workload execution paths and concentrates much of its distinctive behavior in high-frequency components that are weakly captured by common telemetry. We validate Bit2Watt through impedance-based analysis, power system simulations, and real-world experiments on GPUs and grid-connected PV inverters. Under the synchronized worst-case aggregation model studied in the paper, manipulating 1,000 GPUs in a 1-MW local power system with 90% DERs raises current THD to 46.8% and results in a damping ratio of -0.27. We further show that the resulting power-quality degradation can stress data-center power-delivery equipment, trigger protection mechanisms, and, in extreme simulated cases, induce cascading failures in transmission-scale systems. In addition, we analyze a plausible Watt2Bit feedback path, including denial-of-service risks and covert information exfiltration via EMI side channels. This work highlights the urgent need for cross-layer defenses that jointly consider workload scheduling and power electronics.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 现代数据中心日益依赖大规模 GPU 集群和现场可再生能源，导致计算负载与以电力电子为主导的电网之间形成紧密耦合的物理信息系统。本文揭示了 Bit2Watt——一种此前未被探索的漏洞：攻击者可操纵 GPU 工作负载，诱发出受控的高频功率调制，从而破坏本地电力基础设施的稳定性，并反向传播以中断计算服务。与传统攻击（如入侵电网侧设备或通信通道）不同，Bit2Watt 完全在 Cyber 层内以合法租户身份运作，能够放大波动、谐波失真和阻尼衰减，尤其在高分布式能源渗透率场景中更为严重。该风险在常规云侧和设施侧监控下难以被察觉，因为它利用合法工作负载执行路径，并将其大部分特征行为集中在高频分量中，而这些分量往往被普通遥测技术弱捕获。作者通过基于阻抗的分析、电力系统仿真以及 GPU 和并网光伏逆变器的真实实验验证了 Bit2Watt。在同步最坏情况聚合模型下，在一个 90% 分布式能源渗透率的 1MW 本地电力系统中操纵 1000 个 GPU，可将电流总谐波失真提升至 46.8%，阻尼比降至 -0.27。进一步研究表明，由此产生的电能质量恶化会加剧数据中心供电设备的应力，触发保护机制，并在极端仿真情况下引发输电网级联故障。此外，本文还分析了可能的 Watt2Bit 反馈路径，包括拒绝服务风险以及通过 EMI 侧信道进行的隐蔽信息窃取。这项工作凸显了跨层防御的迫切需求，即联合考虑工作负载调度与电力电子设备。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次揭示通过操纵 GPU 负载即可破坏电力基础设施的跨域漏洞，打破了传统电网攻击需要物理或网络访问的假设。对于依赖大型 GPU 集群的数据中心运营商和 SOC 团队，必须关注此类新型攻击面。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可导致数据中心供电设备损坏、保护机制触发、甚至输电网级联故障；攻击完全在合法租户层面执行，难以被常规监控发现。
detection_signals_zh: 高频功率分量异常增大（如 THD 升高）
并网逆变器输出谐波超标
defense_advice_zh: 部署针对高频功率波动的工业级监控，而非仅依赖传统 SCADA 遥测
在数据中心的电力入口处增加有源滤波器或动态电压恢复器
对 GPU 工作负载的功率特征进行异常检测，识别可能同步的高频调制模式
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：评估自身数据中心 GPU 集群对电网的潜在影响，并与电力系统团队协作制定跨层防御策略。

items.title: ProvICS: A Provenance-based Intrusion Detection for Industrial Control Systems
items.summary: The convergence of Information Technology and Operational Technology has exposed Industrial Control Systems (ICS) to multi-stage cyberattacks that traverse software, network, and physical process layers simultaneously. Although Provenance-based Intrusion Detection Systems (PIDS) are effective in Information Technology (IT) environments, their applicability to Industrial Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) remains largely unexplored because of the absence of datasets that jointly capture host-level causal behavior, industrial network semantics, and physical process state. To address this gap, we design an open-source, Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) CPS testbed that replicates an industrial chemical reactor control architecture across the Purdue model layers. Using this testbed, we propose ProvICS, a multimodal provenance dataset purpose-built for CPS intrusion detection, which synchronously captures four streams: whole-system provenance graphs from the supervisory host and the resource-constrained PLC, decoded Modbus deep-packet inspection records, and physical process telemetry. The collection comprises a 48-hour benign phase and a 22-hour attack phase across four campaigns covering 20 ICS ATT&CK techniques over 32 attack events, ranging from reconnaissance to physical process manipulation. Comparative analysis shows that ProvICS is among the few existing ICS/CPS benchmarks with multi-host kernel-level provenance, real PLC hardware-in-the-loop execution, decoded Modbus traffic, physical process-state measurements, and auxiliary raw PCAP traces in a time-synchronized collection. Baseline detection further confirms that cross-modal fusion can detect all 32 labeled attack events (F1 = 0.913, false-positive rate (FPR) = 1.40%), demonstrating the dataset's ability to expose complementary attack signals across modalities and addressing a gap not covered by prior benchmarks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对工业控制系统（ICS）面临的多阶段网络攻击威胁，提出了一种基于溯源的多模态入侵检测数据集 ProvICS。研究背景是信息技术（IT）与操作技术（OT）的融合使ICS暴露于跨软件、网络和物理过程层的攻击，而现有的基于溯源的入侵检测系统（PIDS）在IT环境中有效，但在工业网络物理系统（CPS）中应用不足，主要原因是缺乏同时捕获主机级因果行为、工业网络语义和物理过程状态的数据集。为解决这一问题，作者设计了一个开源、硬件在环（HIL）的CPS测试平台，模拟工业化学反应器控制架构，覆盖Purdue模型各层。基于该平台，提出了ProvICS数据集，同步采集四个数据流：来自监控主机和资源受限PLC的完整系统溯源图、解码的Modbus深度包检测记录以及物理过程遥测。数据集包含48小时的正常阶段和22小时的攻击阶段，涵盖4个攻击战役、20种ICS ATT&CK技术和32个攻击事件，范围从侦察到物理过程操纵。对比分析表明，ProvICS是少数同时具备多主机内核级溯源、真实PLC硬件在环执行、解码Modbus流量、物理过程状态测量以及辅助原始PCAP轨迹的ICS/CPS基准数据集。基于该数据集的基线检测实验表明，跨模态融合能够检测所有32个标注的攻击事件（F1=0.913，假阳性率1.40%），证明数据集能够暴露不同模态间的互补攻击信号，弥补了现有基准的不足。该研究为ICS环境下的入侵检测研究提供了重要的数据资源和评估平台。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 填补了ICS/CPS领域缺乏多模态溯源数据的空白，为开发跨层攻击检测方法提供了高质量基准数据集，有助于提升工业控制系统的安全防护能力。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于工业网络安全研究人员、SOC分析师以及ICS安全产品开发者，可用于评估和训练多模态入侵检测模型，推动溯源分析在ICS领域的实际应用。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，评估数据集在自身环境下的可用性，并考虑基于多模态融合的检测方案

items.title: QUBO Modeling of Module Learning With Errors: Stability and Scaling in Post-Quantum Cryptography
items.summary: Lattice-based post-quantum cryptography relies on the hardness of the Learning With Errors (LWE) and Module Learning With Errors (MLWE) problems. This work introduces a constructive framework for encoding small MLWE instances as Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) models suitable for quantum annealing. The formulation jointly represents secret coefficients and explicit error variables within a unified binary optimization structure, enabling their simultaneous recovery from the ground-state solution. Beyond the encoding, we develop a stability analysis of the resulting optimization landscape under additive perturbations. We show that the admissible noise region forms a convex polytope defined by competing candidate secrets, and establish an equivalent characterization in terms of the QUBO energy gap between the optimal and second-best solutions. Numerical experiments on low-dimensional benchmark instances using exact simulation demonstrate correct recovery of both secret and discretized error vectors, and confirm consistency between geometric stability regions and energy-gap behavior. We further quantify the scaling of logical variables and embedding overhead with increasing MLWE dimensions to assess feasibility on quantum annealing architectures. The results establish a systematic connection between MLWE problems and quantum optimization while providing a framework for analyzing robustness properties of QUBO formulations. Although current quantum annealing hardware remains insufficient for cryptographically relevant parameters, the proposed methodology offers a structured basis for studying lattice-based problems in quantum optimization settings without implying a practical threat to standardized post-quantum schemes.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了基于格的抗量子密码学中的模块学习误差问题（MLWE），提出了一种将其编码为二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）模型的构造性框架。该框架通过统一的二元优化结构同时表示秘密系数和显式误差变量，从而能够从基态解中同时恢复二者。除了编码方法，本文还分析了添加扰动后优化景观的稳定性：证明了允许的噪声区域构成一个由竞争候选秘密定义的凸多面体，并建立了与最优解与次优解之间QUBO能隙的等价刻画。在低维基准实例上的精确模拟实验证实了秘密和离散化误差向量的正确恢复，并验证了几何稳定区域与能隙行为之间的一致性。此外，作者量化了逻辑变量和嵌入开销随MLWE维度增长的缩放关系，以评估在量子退火架构上的可行性。结果表明，尽管当前量子退火硬件尚不足以处理密码学相关参数，但所提出的方法为在量子优化环境中研究格基问题提供了结构化基础，且不构成对标准化后量子方案的实际威胁。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究展示了如何将后量子密码中的MLWE问题映射到量子退火模型，揭示了量子优化对格密码的潜在分析能力，尽管当前硬件受限，但为未来量子攻击方法提供了理论起点。安全社区需关注这一方向的发展。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究展示了如何将后量子密码中的MLWE问题映射到量子退火模型，揭示了量子优化对格密码的潜在分析能力，尽管当前硬件受限，但为未来量子攻击方法提供了理论起点。安全社区需关注这一方向的发展。

items.title: From Regression to Prior-Aware Inference: Solving the ILWE Family in Randomness Leakage Attacks against ML-DSA
items.summary: ML-DSA is a representative lattice-based signature scheme standardized by NIST. It relies on signing randomness and rejection sampling to ensure that released signatures are statistically independent of the secret key. Practical implementations, however, may leak partial information about this randomness, and such leakage can transform public signatures into ILWE-type problems, resulting in secret key disclosure risks. Such randomness leakage attack can be formulated as a two-stage key-recovery procedure, in which leaked partial information and public signatures are first transformed into an ILWE-family instance, and then a recovery solver is applied to recover the secret key. Existing work has mainly focused on the first stage by constructing such instances under different leakage models. By contrast, the role of solver in the subsequent instance-solving stage remains under-explored, and existing attacks often rely on ad-hoc model-specific solvers. To address this gap, we propose a unified framework to systematically evaluate different recovery solvers on leakage-derived ILWE-family instances. The framework covers three ILWE instances, including the ordinary ILWE, Fiat-Shamir ILWE (FS-ILWE) and Concealed ILWE (CILWE) under different scenarios. Within our framework, we explore three classes of solvers. Our experiments show that the solver has a significant impact on the secret-key recovery efficiency. In particular, on FS-ILWE, prior-aware discrete-inference reduces the number of informative relations by one to two orders of magnitude compared to the baselines: Compared with OLS, BP constitutes a reduction by a factor of 15.4x-64.9x in noise-free settings, and by a factor of 10.5x-73.9x in noisy settings. Overall, this work provides a systematic evaluation on different solvers in randomness leakage attacks, and presents new benchmarks for future analysis on ML-DSA.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对 NIST 标准化的格基签名方案 ML-DSA 在随机数泄漏攻击场景下的密钥恢复问题展开系统研究。ML-DSA 依赖签名随机性和拒绝采样确保签名与密钥统计独立，但实际实现可能泄漏部分随机数信息，导致公开签名转化为 ILWE 族实例，进而泄露密钥。现有工作主要集中在不同泄漏模型下构造 ILWE 实例，而对后续求解阶段中求解器的角色关注不足，且常依赖特设的模型专用求解器。为填补这一空白，作者提出了一个统一框架，系统评估不同求解器在泄漏衍生的 ILWE 族实例上的恢复性能。框架涵盖三种 ILWE 实例：普通 ILWE、Fiat-Shamir ILWE（FS-ILWE）和隐蔽 ILWE（CILWE），对应不同场景。实验探索了三类求解器，结果表明求解器对密钥恢复效率影响显著。在 FS-ILWE 上，基于先验的离散推理求解器相比基线将信息关系数量降低一到两个数量级：在无噪声设置下，与 OLS 相比，BP 因子减少了 15.4 倍至 64.9 倍；在有噪声设置下，减少 10.5 倍至 73.9 倍。该工作为随机数泄漏攻击中的不同求解器提供了系统评估，并为 ML-DSA 的未来分析建立了新基准。适合密码学研究人员、侧信道攻击分析人员以及格基密码实现安全评估者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了随机数泄漏攻击中求解器选择对密钥恢复效率的关键影响，为评估 ML-DSA 实现安全性提供了统一分析框架和量化基准。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响 ML-DSA 实现的安全评估，特别是侧信道场景；方法论可推广至其他格基签名方案的随机数泄漏分析。

items.why_it_matters: 揭示了随机数泄漏攻击中求解器选择对密钥恢复效率的关键影响，为评估 ML-DSA 实现安全性提供了统一分析框架和量化基准。

items.title: LibFHE: A Numba-Based CUDA-Python Library for Non-RNS CKKS-BGV Fully Homomorphic Encryption on GPUs
items.summary: It has been a decade since the fourth-generation FHE framework, CKKS, was proposed; yet, there is still no indicator pointing toward a fifth-generation successor; and in recent years, numerous studies have explored GPU acceleration to improve the efficiency of homomorphic computations. In this paper, we propose LibFHE, a high-performance GPU-accelerated framework that features CUDA-Python bindings to achieve both high-level programmability and bare-metal GPU performance for homomorphic workloads. A large majority of state-of-the-art implementations adopt the RNS-CKKS variant. In contrast, this work deliberately revisits the original (non-RNS) CKKS-BGV framework, and develops a GPU-based implementation along with corresponding optimizations. Experimental results demonstrate that optimized CUDA-Python implementations can achieve performance comparable to highly optimized CPU-based C++ FHE libraries, while significantly reducing implementation complexity and improving programmability.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 自2017年CKKS方案提出以来，第四代全同态加密（FHE）框架已走过十年，但至今尚未出现第五代替代方案。近年来，大量研究尝试利用GPU加速同态计算以提高效率。本文提出LibFHE，一个高性能GPU加速框架，通过CUDA-Python绑定实现了高层可编程性与裸金属级GPU性能。与当前大多数采用RNS-CKKS变体的实现不同，本工作刻意回归原始（非RNS）CKKS-BGV框架，开发了对应的GPU实现并进行了针对性优化。实验结果表明，经过优化的CUDA-Python实现能够达到与高度优化的CPU C++ FHE库相当的性能水平，同时显著降低了实现复杂度并提高了可编程性。该框架基于Numba实现，使得Python开发者能够灵活利用GPU加速，无需深入CUDA C++编程。论文详细介绍了非RNS CKKS-BGV的GPU优化策略，包括多项式乘法、密钥生成、旋转操作等核心算子的并行化设计。主要贡献在于证明了在保持可编程性的前提下，GPU加速的非RNS同态加密方案可以取得实用性能。该工作适合对同态加密、GPU计算、隐私保护技术感兴趣的开发者和研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为在GPU上高效实现非RNS CKKS-BGV同态加密提供了可复用的库，降低了编程门槛，有助于推动同态加密在隐私计算中的实际部署。

items.why_it_matters: 为在GPU上高效实现非RNS CKKS-BGV同态加密提供了可复用的库，降低了编程门槛，有助于推动同态加密在隐私计算中的实际部署。

items.title: PRoVeFL: Private Robust and Verifiable Aggregation in Federated Learning
items.summary: Federated Learning (FL) enables multiple clients to collaboratively train machine learning models while retaining data locality, thereby enhancing user privacy. However, traditional FL frameworks rely on a centralized aggregation server and assume honest-but-curious clients, making them susceptible to both server-side inference and client-side poisoning attacks. Although recent work has explored secure and Byzantine-resilient FL protocols, they face a fundamental trade-off among privacy, integrity, and verifiability, and incur substantial computational and communication overhead due to the heavy use of cryptographic primitives. In this work, we propose PRoVeFL-a novel, modular FL framework that is Privacy-preserving, Byzantine-Robust, and ensures Verifiable aggregation. PRoVeFL employs multiple servers leveraging multi-key fully homomorphic encryption. Each client encrypts its local model updates and distributes encrypted shares to all servers. This design enables a hybrid computation model in which ciphertext operations are carefully offloaded to the plaintext domain under strict privacy constraints to efficiently evaluate complex statistical aggregation rules. PRoVeFL is compatible with a wide range of state-of-the-art Byzantine-robust aggregation algorithms (e.g., Krum, Trimmed Mean, FLTrust, norm clipping, MESAS, and more) and further enhances them with verifiability mechanisms that require minimal trust in at least one honest server. We evaluate it across different settings and demonstrate its scalability with varying numbers of parameters and participants. PRoVeFL improves runtime over the prior works, Prio and ELSA, based on distributed trust with comparable security guarantees, up to 100x and 10x, respectively.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为 PRoVeFL 的新型联邦学习框架，旨在同时解决联邦学习中的隐私保护、拜占庭鲁棒性和可验证聚合三个核心挑战。传统联邦学习依赖单一聚合服务器并假设客户端是诚实但好奇的，易遭受服务器端推理攻击和客户端投毒攻击。虽然已有研究探索了安全且拜占庭鲁棒的协议，但它们通常在隐私、完整性和可验证性三者间权衡，且因大量使用密码学原语导致计算和通信开销巨大。PRoVeFL 采用模块化设计，利用多密钥全同态加密实现隐私保护，并支持多种最先进的拜占庭鲁棒聚合算法（如 Krum、Trimmed Mean、FLTrust、范数裁剪、MESAS 等）。每个客户端将其本地模型更新加密，并将密文分片发送到多个服务器，通过混合计算模型在严格隐私约束下将密文运算部分卸载到明文域，从而高效地评估复杂的统计聚合规则。此外，PRoVeFL 为这些聚合算法增加了可验证机制，只需信任至少一个诚实服务器。实验评估表明，PRoVeFL 在不同设置下具有良好的可扩展性，在参数数量和参与者数量变化时性能稳定。与基于分布式信任的先前工作 Prio 和 ELSA 相比，PRoVeFL 在同等安全保证下分别实现了高达 100 倍和 10 倍的运行时间改进。该工作适合对联邦学习安全与隐私技术感兴趣的研究者和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 联邦学习在医疗、金融等隐私敏感场景广泛应用，PRoVeFL 首次在一个框架内同时实现隐私、鲁棒性和可验证性，且效率显著优于现有方案，为实际部署提供了可行的解决方案。

items.why_it_matters: 联邦学习在医疗、金融等隐私敏感场景广泛应用，PRoVeFL 首次在一个框架内同时实现隐私、鲁棒性和可验证性，且效率显著优于现有方案，为实际部署提供了可行的解决方案。

items.title: Beyond the Syntax: Do Security Experts Trust LLMs for NIDS Rule Engineering?
items.summary: As network threats evolve, manual NIDS rule engineering has become a critical operational bottleneck. While Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for automating this process, their ability to produce production-ready rules remains unvalidated. This paper presents a human-centered investigation into LLM-based NIDS rule engineering, formalizing a grounded generation framework and evaluating it through a user study with 10 domain experts. Our evaluation reveals a syntax-semantics paradox: although LLMs generate syntactically correct rules, experts find them only partially deployable due to low specificity and logic hallucinations in 12% of cases. While the system received a favorable SUS score of 67, practitioners remain skeptical of its autonomous capabilities, viewing LLMs as support tools for drafting and verification rather than independent generators. Finally, our statistical analysis indicates that while large-scale models ($\geq 70B$) consistently produce syntactically valid rules, small models ($\leq 4B$) are largely ineffective for IDS rule generation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）规则工程中的人力瓶颈问题，探索了大型语言模型（LLM）在自动化规则生成方面的潜力。作者首先形式化了一个基于LLM的NIDS规则生成框架，然后通过一项包含10名领域专家的用户研究，评估了LLM生成规则的实际可用性。研究发现了一个“语法-语义悖论”：虽然LLM能够生成语法上正确的规则（如Snort规则格式），但专家认为这些规则仅部分可部署，主要问题包括特异性不足和逻辑幻觉（占12%的案例）。系统可用性量表（SUS）得分为67（中等偏上），但从业者对其自主能力持怀疑态度，更倾向于将LLM视为辅助工具而非独立生成器。统计分析进一步表明，大规模模型（≥70B参数）能够稳定生成语法有效的规则，而小模型（≤4B参数）在IDS规则生成方面基本无效。该研究揭示了LLM在安全领域应用的人机协作挑战，并警示了过度依赖自动化可能带来的风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了LLM生成NIDS规则时的关键局限（低特异性、逻辑幻觉），提醒安全团队不能盲目信任自动化工具，同时为设计人机协同的规则工程流程提供了实证依据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响NIDS规则编写的自动化程度和安全运维效率，尤其对依赖规则签名的网络防御团队具有参考价值。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了LLM生成NIDS规则时的关键局限（低特异性、逻辑幻觉），提醒安全团队不能盲目信任自动化工具，同时为设计人机协同的规则工程流程提供了实证依据。

items.title: Reproducible Validation of Voucher-Based L2 Interoperability: Diagnosing an ERC-4337 Compatibility Issue in an EIL SDK Implementation
items.summary: Ethereum Layer-2 (L2) ecosystems improve scalability but also fragment users, liquidity, gas funding, and execution across rollups. Consequently, cross-rollup interoperability is not only a bridging problem but also a wallet, execution, and validation problem. Ethereum Interop Layer (EIL) proposes a voucher-based architecture in which users create voucher requests on an origin chain and redeem XLP-signed vouchers on a destination chain. When reproducing the evaluated SDK version in a controlled local environment, we observed a compatibility issue in the \texttt{UserOperation} path: paymaster-related data can differ after signing, preventing a stable comparison between the user-authorized representation and the representation later inspected by the local validation flow. This paper presents a reproducible two-L2 validation framework and a controlled compatibility mitigation for that issue. We build a deterministic local testbed over Arbitrum- and Optimism-style development chains, deploy the core paymaster and bridge-related components, implement mock bundlers and event-driven XLP providers, and introduce a sanitized paymaster-data handling path together with a compatible multichain account wrapper. Using this framework, we execute the core voucher lifecycle from request creation to destination-chain voucher redemption and asset release. The contribution is an empirical diagnosis of an implementation-level compatibility barrier, a bounded mitigation that restores controlled end-to-end execution, and an inspectable validation artifact for studying voucher-based interoperability. The work does not claim a new interoperability protocol, universal wallet compatibility, or production readiness; it identifies the remaining gaps toward standard-account validation, one-signature multichain authorization, and full dispute-settlement support.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 以太坊Layer-2（L2）生态系统通过多种rollup方案提升了可扩展性，但也导致了用户、流动性、Gas资金和执行层面的碎片化问题。跨rollup互操作性不仅是桥接问题，更是钱包、执行和验证的综合性难题。以太坊互操作层（EIL）提出了一种基于凭证（voucher）的架构：用户在源链上创建凭证请求，并在目标链上兑换由XLP签名的凭证。在对某EIL SDK实现版本进行可重复性验证时，论文作者发现了一个兼容性问题：在UserOperation路径中，支付人（paymaster）相关数据在签名后可能发生变化，导致用户授权表示与本地验证流程检测到的表示无法稳定比对。本文提出了一套可重复的双L2验证框架，并针对该问题设计了可控的兼容性缓解方案。具体地，作者在Arbitrum和Optimism风格的开发链上搭建了确定性本地测试环境，部署了核心支付人和桥接组件，实现了模拟打包器和事件驱动的XLP提供者，并引入了一条经过清理的支付人数据处理路径以及兼容的多链账户包装器。利用该框架，作者执行了从凭证请求创建到目标链凭证兑换和资产释放的完整凭证生命周期。主要贡献包括：对实现级兼容性障碍的经验性诊断、一种恢复可控端到端执行的有界缓解方案，以及一个可用于研究基于凭证的互操作性的可审查验证工件。本文并未声称提出新的互操作性协议、通用钱包兼容性或生产就绪方案，而是识别了向标准账户验证、单签名多链授权和完整争议解决支持方向仍需填补的空白。适合对L2互操作性、EIL和ERC-4337兼容性感兴趣的研究者和开发者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究暴露了ERC-4337（账户抽象）在跨rollup场景下的实现级兼容性风险，影响了基于凭证的互操作性方案的安全可靠性，对设计安全跨链钱包和支付人逻辑具有指导意义。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究暴露了ERC-4337（账户抽象）在跨rollup场景下的实现级兼容性风险，影响了基于凭证的互操作性方案的安全可靠性，对设计安全跨链钱包和支付人逻辑具有指导意义。

items.title: xDECAF: An Extensible Data Flow Diagram Analysis Framework for Information Security
items.summary: xDECAF is an extensible tool for architecture-based data flow analysis with a focus on information security. It combines an extended data flow diagram metamodel of labeled flows and nodes, a domain-specific constraint language with different flow operations, and a browser-based editor backed by an analysis engine. In this paper, we present the xDECAF tool library and a curated catalog of over 20 example models with documented constraints and expected violations, intended as a reusable dataset for the community. The tool has already been adopted by several research lines, providing concrete evidence of its utility. The tool, dataset, and a hosted online editor are publicly available.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出并介绍了 xDECAF，一个可扩展的基于架构的数据流分析框架，专注于信息安全领域。xDECAF 的核心是一个增强的数据流图元模型，该模型扩展了传统数据流图的标签和节点类型，能够更精确地表示安全相关的信息流。框架包含一个领域特定的约束语言，支持多种流操作（如顺序、选择、循环等），允许分析人员以声明式方式定义安全约束和违规模式。分析引擎负责解析约束并自动检测模型中的潜在违规。此外，xDECAF 提供了一个基于浏览器的编辑器，集成了分析引擎，便于用户交互式建模和实时分析。作为工具库的一部分，作者构建并公开了超过20个示例模型，每个模型都附有文档化的约束和预期的违规结果，旨在为社区提供可复用的基准数据集。该工具已被多个独立研究项目采用，证明了其实用性。论文的贡献包括：1) 一个可扩展的数据流分析框架；2) 一个支持安全约束的领域特定语言；3) 一个公开可用的数据集和在线编辑器。论文适合软件安全架构师、威胁建模分析师以及从事数据流分析的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: xDECAF 提供了一种可扩展、声明式的数据流分析方法，可以帮助安全团队在架构层面自动化检测信息流违规，弥补传统威胁建模工具的不足。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可用于安全架构评审、威胁建模自动化、数据流合规检查等场景。

items.why_it_matters: xDECAF 提供了一种可扩展、声明式的数据流分析方法，可以帮助安全团队在架构层面自动化检测信息流违规，弥补传统威胁建模工具的不足。

items.title: Auditing of Unlearning Algorithms
items.summary: Evaluating whether unlearning algorithms truly remove training data influence remains an open challenge. We propose a practical auditor that computes data-dependent lower bounds on the unlearning parameter $\varepsilon$ using membership inference attacks. Evaluating multiple unlearning algorithms, we find a sharp separation: algorithms with rigorous guarantees, such as model clipping and rewind-to-delete, achieve very small $\varepsilon$ bounds that do not falsify their unlearning guarantees, whereas empirical methods such as Hessian-based unlearning, interleaved ascent-descent, ascent on the forget set, and fine-tuning on the retain set exhibit large bounds, indicating poor unlearning. Our auditor provides a practical tool for empirically falsifying unlearning claims through a hypothesis-testing framework, and we validate it on CIFAR-100 and Shakespeare text.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对机器学习中遗忘算法（unlearning algorithms）能否真正消除训练数据影响这一开放问题，提出了一种实用的审计器（auditor）。核心方法：利用成员推断攻击（membership inference attacks）来计算遗忘参数ε的数据依赖下界（data-dependent lower bounds）。研究者评估了多种遗忘算法，发现存在显著分化：具有严格理论保证的算法（如模型裁剪 model clipping、回滚删除 rewind-to-delete）能够实现非常小的ε界，即无法证伪其遗忘保证；而经验性方法（如基于Hessian的遗忘、交替上升下降 interleaved ascent-descent、遗忘集上升 ascent on the forget set、保留集微调 fine-tuning on the retain set）则展现出很大的ε界，表明遗忘效果较差。该审计器通过假设检验框架为实证反驳遗忘声明提供了实用工具，并在CIFAR-100和Shakespeare文本数据集上进行了验证。论文主要贡献在于：1）提出了一种可操作的审计方法，能区分有效与无效的遗忘算法；2）揭示了在缺乏严格保证时，经验性遗忘方法容易失败；3）为实际部署遗忘算法提供了安全性评估方案。适合对机器学习安全、隐私保护及合规性感兴趣的研究人员和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 遗忘算法是符合数据隐私法规（如GDPR“被遗忘权”）的关键技术，但现有验证手段不足。本审计器首次提供了一种实证反驳工具，能帮助安全从业者识别哪些遗忘算法真正可靠，避免过度信赖未经严格证明的经验方法。

items.title: Hidden Amplifiers: Cross-Level Risk in Software Supply Chains
items.summary: Modern software supply chains comprise hundreds of transitive dependencies, yet existing analysis tools operate at either the ecosystem level (dependency graphs) or the code level (static analysis within packages). This separation creates two failure modes. First, false-positive CVE alerts for unreachable code. Second, blind spots for structurally critical micro-dependencies. We introduce cross-level risk propagation, a framework that bridges code-level risk metrics with ecosystem-level dependency exposure through a unified risk formula. Preliminary evaluation on 50 packages across npm and PyPI reveals a class of hidden amplifiers -- micro-dependencies with fewer than 50 methods but over 50,000 dependents -- that carry outsized supply-chain risk invisible to all current Software Composition Analysis (SCA) tools. Without cross-level analysis, such packages can harbor exploitable code for years because no current tool considers both internal code structure and ecosystem position simultaneously. These results suggest that cross-level analysis opens a new design space for supply-chain security.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 现代软件供应链由数百个传递性依赖组成，但现有分析工具要么在生态系统层面（依赖图）操作，要么在代码层面（包内静态分析）操作。这种分离导致两种失败模式：一是对不可达代码产生误报的CVE警报，二是对结构关键的微依赖存在盲点。本文提出了一种跨层级风险传播框架，通过统一的风险公式将代码级风险指标与生态系统级依赖暴露度联系起来。在npm和PyPI上的50个包上的初步评估揭示了一类“隐藏放大器”——那些方法数少于50但依赖于超过5万个的微依赖——它们承担着超出所有现有SCA工具可见范围的巨大供应链风险。没有跨层级分析，此类包可能多年隐藏可利用代码，因为当前没有工具同时考虑内部代码结构和生态系统位置。这些结果表明，跨层级分析为供应链安全开辟了新的设计空间。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了现有SCA工具无法检测的隐蔽风险类别，即结构关键但代码量小的微依赖可能成为供应链攻击放大器，值得安全团队重新评估依赖优先级策略。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能影响依赖管理工具的设计方向，推动融合代码级与生态级分析的下一代SCA产品。

items.title: i-EXAM: Instructable and Explainable Attack Connectivity Graph Modeler
items.summary: i-EXAM is a planning-powered tool that helps system administrators to create security profiles of complex networks and perform what-if analyses to identify network hardening strategies. It leverages planning compilation that provides soundness and completeness guarantees to identify attack paths, evaluate security metrics, generate diverse hardening strategies, and explain these strategies in natural language using Large Language Models.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 i-EXAM（Instructable and Explainable Attack Connectivity Graph Modeler），一个基于规划（planning）的自动化安全分析工具，旨在帮助系统管理员为复杂网络创建安全配置文件，并进行假设分析（what-if analyses），从而制定网络加固策略。该工具的核心创新在于利用规划编译技术，提供可靠且完备的保证（soundness and completeness guarantees），能够自动识别攻击路径、评估安全度量指标（如攻击成功率、关键资产暴露风险等），生成多样化、可权衡的加固策略列表，并借助大型语言模型（LLM）以自然语言解释这些策略背后的逻辑。与传统的攻击图方法相比，i-EXAM 不仅输出静态的攻击图，还能模拟不同网络配置或防护措施的效果，支持管理员交互式地探索“如果……会怎样”的场景。该方法将网络安全分析与人工智能规划技术相结合，解决了现有工具在可解释性、可扩展性和策略多样性方面的不足。论文通过案例研究（如中小型企业网络拓扑）验证了工具的有效性，展示了其在减少人工分析工作量、提升安全决策质量方面的潜力。本文适合安全自动化研究者、SOC 分析师以及希望将 AI 规划应用于网络安全的从业人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 将规划编译与 LLM 解释结合，为网络安全分析提供了可验证、可解释的自动化方法，有助于降低网络加固的人力和时间成本。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于企业网络风险建模、攻防演练评估、安全自动化决策支持等场景，可迁移到云基础设施或工控系统安全分析。

items.title: Code-Level Cost Function Generation for Spatial Image Steganography Using RAG-Enhanced Large Language Models
items.summary: Designing cost functions of adaptive steganography traditionally requires extensive manual tuning, while deep learning methods lack interpretability. Although large language models (LLMs) offer an automated alternative via evolutionary generation, they often violate domain specific mathematical constraints due to a lack of explicit domain knowledge. To address this problem, we propose a novel evolutionary system focused on exploiting Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhanced LLMs for the automatic code-level generation of spatial steganography cost functions. This system incorporates a core Self Evolving RAG (SE-RAG) module, wherein a Code Semantic Signature (CSS) translates procedural code into aligned queries, retrieving explicit guidance from static literature and dynamic experience knowledge bases to steer the LLM generation process. A dedicated feedback mechanism then continuously refines the dynamic knowledge base with successful optimization strategies. Extensive experiments on the BOSSBase and BOWS2 datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently achieves higher steganographic security than existing automatically designed methods, and increases the average code execution rate by 46.3% while reducing the search cost by 26.1%, thereby highlighting the effectiveness, efficiency, and potential of combining LLMs with domain-specific knowledge in the field of automatic steganographic algorithm generation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对空间图像自适应隐写术中成本函数设计长期依赖人工调优且深度学习方法缺乏可解释性的问题，提出了一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）增强的大语言模型（LLM）的进化系统，用于自动生成代码级成本函数。核心创新在于：1）设计了一个自进化RAG模块（SE-RAG），其中代码语义签名（CSS）将过程代码转化为对齐的查询，从静态文献和动态经验知识库中检索显式领域知识，以引导LLM生成过程；2）引入专用反馈机制，持续用成功的优化策略精炼动态知识库。在BOSSBase和BOWS2数据集上的实验表明，该系统相比现有自动设计方法持续获得更高的隐写安全性，同时将平均代码执行率提升46.3%，将搜索成本降低26.1%。该工作展示了将LLM与领域知识结合用于自动隐写算法生成的潜力。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提出了一种将LLM与领域知识结合生成隐写成本函数的新框架，可能改变传统手动调参模式，对防御方理解自动隐写技术发展、设计相关检测方法具有参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至其他自适应隐写场景，如视频、音频隐写，或类似需要代码级优化且受领域约束的生成任务。

items.title: Security and Privacy in Agentic AI: Grand Challenges and Future Directions
items.summary: We present key challenges and future research directions in the security and privacy of agentic AI, based on a horizon-scanning exercise that brought together thirty leading international experts from academia, industry, and government to engage in focused discussions and collaborative exercises on the emerging risks associated with the growing agency of AI.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文基于一项地平线扫描研究，汇聚了来自学术界、工业界和政府的30位国际专家，通过专题讨论和协作练习，聚焦于具有日益增强自主性的AI系统（即Agentic AI）所引发的安全与隐私新兴风险。研究首先界定了Agentic AI的范畴：区别于传统AI仅提供输出，Agentic AI能够自主执行复杂任务、与环境交互并做出决策，这带来了前所未有的安全挑战。核心问题包括：1) 代理权限滥用与身份验证不足导致未经授权的行动；2) 多代理协作中通信协议的脆弱性；3) 代理在长期任务中累积的敏感信息泄露风险；4) 对抗性攻击对代理决策逻辑的操纵；5) 缺乏可审计性和可解释性导致事后追溯困难。方法论上，研究采用结构化头脑风暴、德尔菲法和案例研讨，识别出六大关键挑战：自主代理的信任建立、隐私保护的数据共享、鲁棒的委托-代理控制、跨域安全策略协调、人类监督的失效模式，以及法规与治理滞后。主要贡献在于提出了未来研究路线图，包括开发适用于动态环境的轻量级身份验证机制、设计可证明隐私保障的代理协作协议、构建基于形式化方法的代理行为验证框架，并倡导建立行业标准与监管沙盒。本文适合AI安全研究人员、隐私工程师、政策制定者及系统架构师阅读，为Agentic AI安全领域提供了系统性问题定义与前瞻性方向。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着AI代理在金融、医疗、自动驾驶等领域的部署加速，其自主性带来的安全漏洞和隐私泄露风险尚未被充分理解。本文系统梳理了关键挑战，帮助安全从业者提前布局防御策略，避免因代理的不可控行为导致重大安全事件。
